key.name: kinetic-scrolling
key.description: When false (default), per-event scroll deltas are capped so the render cache always keeps up with the user's scroll velocity. The user never sees thumbnail placeholders during normal reading scroll; thumbnails are reserved for explicit jumps (TOC click, page-entry edit, search-hit reveal). When true, scroll events apply their full delta with kinetic momentum (a trackpad flick coasts past pages), matching the GTK default. Fast scrolling in this mode will paint thumbnails until the cache catches up.

key.name: reading-ruler
key.description: When true, dim the page everywhere except a horizontal band that tracks the mouse cursor. Useful for dense technical reading where keeping your eye on the active line is the failure mode. Toggleable from the primary menu; the setting persists across sessions.
